comparison_boundary: Metadata and TF-IDF share judged candidates but use different input fields; treat their comparison as an input ablation, not an equal-information algorithm comparison.
graph_leakage_boundary: Judgment pairs present in the supplied curriculum relationship graph are excluded from held-out scoring regardless of relationship type.
limitations: Unjudged candidates are excluded from each ranking and are not treated as negatives.
Coverage is conditional on the reviewed candidate set; it is not full-catalog retrieval recall.
Concept overlap with judgment evidence is reported as a diagnostic and is not causally corrected.
Relationship ranking quality does not show improved learning or transfer.

metrics_definition.direction_accuracy: top-five forward-edge versus none classification; does not compare reverse orientations unless independently labeled
metrics_definition.ndcg_at_5: graded gain 2^relevance-1 against the ideal ordering of judged candidates only
metrics_definition.recall_at_10: graded labels with relevance > 0 retrieved in the top 10, divided by judged positive candidates

provenance.cash_cost_boundary: No billing receipt is available; cost is not measured.

review_boundary: Accepted adjudicator labels are evaluation records; this report does not establish human gold quality or learner benefit.

scoring.candidate_coverage_note: fraction of non-source catalog keys with a reviewed candidate label, macro-averaged by source and relationship type; unjudged candidates were excluded from ranking, not treated as negatives

concept_evidence_overlap.interpretation: lexical overlap diagnostic only; it does not show causal leakage or correct for shared information

direction_coverage.accuracy_definition: top-5 predicts source_to_target; a judged row is positive only when relevance >= 2 and its reviewed direction is source_to_target; all other labels are none
direction_coverage.reverse_direction_boundary: This evaluates forward proposal versus none for the supplied ordered pair; it does not compare both orientations unless the dataset includes independently reviewed reverse candidates.

scoring.paired_uncertainty_cluster_unit: source problem and review family; paired by the same evaluated query groups
